name: Radial Card Deck
description: Full-screen fan of image cards arranged around a far-off pivot. Cards fly in from the sides, settle into a radial deck, and the deck can be dragged to rotate.
contents: Ring of framed image cards arranged radially on a background
behavior: Cards fly in from both sides with staggered rotation and scale, then settle into radial positions
Draggable rotation snaps by one card step on release
Card size steps down on short viewports and is capped to 80vw
editableByProps: Images, colors, card border and radius, grayscale
Card sizes per viewport height, deck radius, animation timing and easing, dragging on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the card entrance direction or spin
Change the height breakpoints for card sizes

fixed: Fills the viewport height as a full-bleed section
Cards are clipped by the container, so the deck is shown as an arc in the lower area
Entrance animation plays once on mount
